name: sqlmap
description: `--update` git-pull or zipball-extract over the source tree; zipball path has zero integrity check.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: sqlmap selects different maintenance paths for pip, Git, and archive installations. These channels should be described separately; the reviewed archive-update implementation does not establish an independently authenticated release manifest.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not historical release re-verification; pip, Git, GitHub archive delivery, and release-side controls were not independently audited.
